Hi,
What are the advatages of running these tests and how long do they take to run?
I think the time it takes to make a merge is quite long and is causing problems for mutiple merges.

Each job takes about 5 minutes. flawfinder looks for C/C++ issues. Bandit looks for Python issues.

* General info about SAST here: https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/application_security/sast/
* Flawfinder project is here: https://github.com/david-a-wheeler/flawfinder
* Bandit project is here: https://github.com/PyCQA/bandit
@AndersBroman : If this were changed to a scheduled pipeline instead, would that resolve all of your concerns?
No strong opinion

@alagoutte : Gitlab changed the associated template path and variable used for controlling which analyzers run (e.g., https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/229974). I've updated both.

It may also make sense to ignore vulnerabilities with a low risk level via SAST_FLAWFINDER_LEVEL (https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/application_security/sast/#vulnerability-filters)

changes_data.diff:
@@ -25,6 +25,8 @@ variables:
   CLANG_VERSION: 14
   # Enable color output in CMake, Ninja, and other tools. https://bixense.com/clicolors/
   CLICOLOR_FORCE: 1
+  # Skip irrelevant SAST scanners:
+  SAST_EXCLUDED_ANALYZERS: "brakeman,eslint,spotbugs"
 
 # Scheduled builds additionally set SCHEDULE_TYPE, which can be one of:
 # - daily: Daily at 10:00 UTC
@@ -904,3 +906,7 @@ Valgrind Menagerie Fuzz:
     - cd ..
     - ./tools/fuzz-test.sh -g -P $MIN_PLUGINS -b $INSTALL_PREFIX/bin -d /tmp/fuzz -t $MAX_SECONDS $( shuf -e /var/menagerie/*/* ) 2> fuzz-test.err || echo "export FUZZ_PASSED=false" > /tmp/fuzz_result.sh
   needs: [ 'ASan randpkt Fuzz' ]
+
+
+include:
+  - template: Security/SAST.gitlab-ci.yml
